title: When the Locker Falls
author: Sebastian Lockridge
blurb: Coral Hartwell, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, has spent seven years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
